row1.total_equity: Microsoft leads Total Equity with $442.4 B, outpacing Alphabet by $27.1 B and Amazon by $31.3 B, highlighting a clear gap among the top three tech giants. JPMorgan Chase follows at $362.4 B, a $80 B drop from Microsoft.

row1.cash_and_equivalents: JPMorgan Chase leads the pack with $343.3 B in cash and equivalents, far outpacing Bank of America’s $239.3 B and Amazon’s $86.8 B, creating a roughly $104 B gap between the top two. Apple and Meta trail with $35.9 B each, a steep drop from the top tier.
